```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Read cleaned data
nba <- read_csv(
  "../Data/processed_data/nba_2025_26_clean.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

nba
```


```{r explore-data}
nrow(nba)

summary(nba)
```

```{r preview-data}
nba |>
  select(
    player,
    team,
    games,
    points_per_game,
    rebounds_per_game,
    assists_per_game,
    steals_per_game,
    blocks_per_game,
    ts_percent,
    per,
    ws,
    bpm,
    vorp
  ) |>
  head(10)
```


```{r ppg-bpm}
top_bpm_players <- nba_analysis |>
  arrange(desc(bpm)) |>
  slice_head(n = 8)

p1 <- ggplot(
  nba_analysis,
  aes(
    x = points_per_game,
    y = bpm
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_bpm_players,
    aes(label = player),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Scoring vs. Overall Impact",
    subtitle = "2025–26 NBA Regular Season",
    x = "Points Per Game",
    y = "Box Plus/Minus (BPM)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p1
```

Save the figure.

```{r save-ppg-bpm}
ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/ppg_vs_bpm.png",
  plot = p1,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```


```{r ts-vorp}
top_vorp_players <- nba_analysis |>
  arrange(desc(vorp)) |>
  slice_head(n = 8)

p2 <- ggplot(
  nba_analysis,
  aes(
    x = ts_percent * 100,
    y = vorp
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_vorp_players,
    aes(label = player),
    size = 4,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Scoring Efficiency vs. Player Value",
    subtitle = "2025–26 NBA Regular Season",
    x = "True Shooting Percentage (%)",
    y = "Value Over Replacement Player (VORP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2
```

Save the figure.

```{r save-ts-vorp}
ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/ts_vs_vorp.png",
  plot = p2,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```



```{r standardize}
nba_analysis <- nba_analysis |>
  mutate(
    z_pts = as.numeric(scale(points_per_game)),
    z_reb = as.numeric(scale(rebounds_per_game)),
    z_ast = as.numeric(scale(assists_per_game)),
    z_ts = as.numeric(scale(ts_percent)),
    z_bpm = as.numeric(scale(bpm)),
    z_vorp = as.numeric(scale(vorp))
  )
```


```{r impact-score}
nba_analysis <- nba_analysis |>
  mutate(
    impact_score = (
      z_pts +
      z_reb +
      z_ast +
      z_ts +
      z_bpm +
      z_vorp
    ) / 6
  )
```


```{r top10}
top10 <- nba_analysis |>
  arrange(desc(impact_score)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  select(
    player,
    team,
    games,
    points_per_game,
    rebounds_per_game,
    assists_per_game,
    ts_percent,
    bpm,
    vorp,
    impact_score
  )

top10
```

```{r impact-bar}
p3 <- top10 |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(player, impact_score),
      y = impact_score
    )
  ) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 NBA Players by Impact Score",
    subtitle = "2025–26 NBA Regular Season",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Impact Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p3
```


```{r save-impact-bar}
ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/impact_top10.png",
  plot = p3,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```


```{r ranking-gap}
nba_rankings <- nba_analysis |>
  mutate(
    scoring_rank = rank(
      -points_per_game,
      ties.method = "min"
    ),
    
    impact_rank = rank(
      -impact_score,
      ties.method = "min"
    ),
    
    rank_difference = scoring_rank - impact_rank
  )
```


```{r underrated}
under_the_radar <- nba_rankings |>
  arrange(desc(rank_difference)) |>
  select(
    player,
    team,
    points_per_game,
    scoring_rank,
    impact_rank,
    rank_difference,
    bpm,
    vorp,
    impact_score
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

under_the_radar
```

# 9. Highest Scorers

For comparison, look at the league's top scorers.

```{r top-scorers}
top_scorers <- nba_analysis |>
  arrange(desc(points_per_game)) |>
  select(
    player,
    team,
    points_per_game,
    bpm,
    vorp,
    impact_score
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_scorers
```

# 10. Correlations

Check how strongly traditional scoring is associated with the advanced impact measures.

```{r correlations}
cor(
  nba_analysis$points_per_game,
  nba_analysis$bpm,
  use = "complete.obs"
)

cor(
  nba_analysis$points_per_game,
  nba_analysis$vorp,
  use = "complete.obs"
)

cor(
  nba_analysis$points_per_game,
  nba_analysis$impact_score,
  use = "complete.obs"
)
```
